inputKind: a String of lowercase words separated by single spaces
inputs: 'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'
'a rose is a rose is a rose'

tasks.prompt: Leave the number of words, as a bare scalar.
Leave a Record mapping each distinct word (String key) to how many times it occurs, keys in order of first occurrence.
Leave a Vector of the distinct words, in order of first occurrence.
Leave a single String: every word with its first letter upper-cased, joined by single spaces.
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS 'C' BIND C 1 TAKE [ UPPER ] MAP C 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN ] MAP 'W' BIND W 1 DROP W 0 GET [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A ' ' X 3 COLLECT JOIN ] FOLD

tasks.prompt: Leave the length (character count) of the longest word, as a bare scalar.
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP SORT -1 GET

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector of the words longer than 3 characters, in their original order (repeats kept).
Leave a single String made of the first letter of every word, upper-cased, in order.
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
